With so many things we have to keep track of today, it's easy to forget to take your medication. Let Pills manage all of your meds, vitamins, contraceptives, refills, drug interactions and measurements to improve your health. 

Pills provides you with a very simple and intuitive platform to remind you to take your medicine. It also tracks how many doses you have left and shows a refill alert when you're running low. You can also customize your pills and take advantage of the new iOS 13 functionalities like critical notifications and dark mode. So lay back and focus on the things that really matter. We'll take care of the rest.
